heading: Specialist Hand Stripping
blockquote: Preserve the natural colour, texture and condition of your dog’s coat.
body:
Hand stripping is a specialist technique used to remove older, dull hairs by hand, allowing healthy new coat to grow through. It is particularly suited to many wire-coated and silky-coated breeds whose coats can lose their correct texture when clipped.

Our experienced groomers assess the coat before recommending the most appropriate grooming method, as hand stripping is not suitable for every dog or every stage of coat growth. When appropriate, it helps retain the coat’s natural appearance and produces a smart, breed-appropriate finish without relying on clippers.
